cases.name: namespaced install
cases.check: installed into session <service>, every place is p-<service>-team-* and every lane t-<service>-team-*

cases.name: registration
cases.check: provision fills the service from the namespace, clones the repository and writes the team into p-product-teams

cases.name: spec before code
cases.check: no context pack is written and no run starts without an approved spec token for the requirement

cases.name: branches only
cases.check: the developer commits on <service>/<specId>; nothing is pushed; merge happens only through the merge command after the person's decision

cases.name: office inbox
cases.check: every question, approval and merge decision waiting for the person is mirrored into p-product-inbox and cleared when answered
